_review: W_NEXT_NOT_LOADED: horde_horde_35-40a is written in a later phase. This band ends at Kargath in the Badlands at level 35; 35-40a must enter there or the entry hub must be changed.

W_XP_RANGE: quest XP is about 58% of the 274100 budget. The remaining solo pool (about 260k) is mostly Undercity, Thunder Bluff, Dustwallow-far and Badlands chains that need three or more extra legs, or quests with no DB position or no XP row. Not padded with dungeon, rep or higher-level mob quests; class XP is not counted.
Handed on from 25-30: 1366 and 676/677 are routed here. 6628, 1152, 1154, 6627 and 1159 (Test of Lore) are not routed (see dropped[]); the chain needs Stonetalon, Ashenvale and Undercity legs.

Elite blockers (E_ELITE_DROPPED, 4 errors): 1113 (prerequisite 1109 has no DB source), 6521 (prerequisite 6522 is an item start with no position), 6983 (Winter Veil chain, prerequisite 6963 is level 60), 97985 (Undercity, no XP row). The validator does not allow an elite drop when the prerequisite is blocked. Needs a decision in the main session.

Flight paths discovered on the route: Urda (Hammerfall), Thalon (Shadowprey), Shardi (Brackenwall), Thysta (Grom'gol), Shyn (Camp Mojache), Gringer (Booty Bay), Breyk (Stonard), Gorrik (Kargath). FLY steps from Hammerfall to Shadowprey, Ratchet and Booty Bay boats, and Booty Bay to Stonard are not verified in the DB; check in game.

Trainers: Orgrimmar at 32 (most Horde classes), Camp Mojache (druid) and Booty Bay (rogue) at 34, Stonard at 34-35 (warlock, warrior, shaman, hunter). Paladin trainers are off the path; Undercity and Thunder Bluff are not visited.
Hunter pet mastery (185-187, 190-191, 194-195) is class-limited with classes HUNTER. The DB has no class mask, so the validator does not require it. Class XP is not counted.
